Name: Daredevil 2099 (Nelson)
Description: The Daredevil of 2099 opted to take the law into his own hands, expressing disappointment in the corrupted legal system of his time. Eric (Daredevil 2099) Nelson was created by Warren Ellis and Dale Eaglesham. His first appearance was in 2099 A. D. Genesis #1 (January 1996).
